content: Severe episodes of hypoglycemia are linked to a heightened risk of developing cognitive decline or dementia. Impaired cognitive function can also increase the likelihood of experiencing severe hypoglycemia, potentially due to a diminished ability to recognize and respond to symptoms of low blood sugar. To address this, healthcare professionals may adjust glycemic targets or A1C goals to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia, especially in patients with existing cognitive impairments. For more comprehensive guidance on managing hypoglycemia in older adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, refer to Section 13, titled Older Adults.
